causes.text: On August 23, 2023, a Reuters report highlighted that investors were pinning their hopes on Nvidia's upcoming earnings to sustain an AI-fuelled stock rally. Nvidia's shares had tripled in 2023, and enthusiasm about artificial-intelligence applications drove the S&P 500 up about 14% for the year. The so-called 'Magnificent Seven' megacap stocks-including Nvidia, Apple and Microsoft-accounted for roughly two-thirds of the index's gains, illustrating how AI optimism dominated market sentiment.

source_info.title: Nvidia rallies as Wall Street anticipates pivotal report

effects.text: When Goldman Sachs released its first-quarter 2024 earnings the following April, the bank's strong trading and underwriting results surprised the market and its shares climbed nearly 5 % to around $408. Analysts credited the earnings beat and heightened trading activity for the rally.

source_info.title: Goldman's plan B unexpectedly upgraded to a B-plus

causal_reasoning_chain.description: In August 2023, AI enthusiasm peaked as Nvidia's stock tripled and the 'Magnificent Seven' megacap stocks drove most of the S&P 500's gains. Investors awaited Nvidia's earnings to see if the rally could continue, illustrating how artificial-intelligence excitement set the tone for markets.

The AI-driven rally encouraged a risk-on environment through late 2023 and early 2024. Elevated trading volumes in technology names spilled over to broader markets, benefiting investment banks' trading desks. In such an environment, firms like Goldman Sachs could capture higher market-making fees and trading revenue.

When Goldman reported its first-quarter 2024 results, strong trading revenue-partly buoyed by the earlier surge in market activity-helped the bank beat expectations. Investors responded by pushing the stock up nearly 5%, demonstrating how earlier AI enthusiasm set the stage for a sizable share-price reaction.

rationale: The effect article attributes Goldman's nearly 5 % share price jump to its earnings beat. The preceding AI-driven market rally helped create the trading conditions that enabled those earnings, linking the August 2023 event to the April 2024 outcome.
counterfactual_analysis: If Nvidia and other AI-centric stocks had not fueled a market boom, trading volumes might have been lower and Goldman's results less impressive. In that case, the bank's share price could have reacted less strongly or even remained flat.

adversarial_confounders.impact: Shifts in Federal Reserve policy between 2023 and 2024 also influenced market sentiment. Rate cuts or hikes could have affected trading volumes independently of the AI rally, muddying the causal link.

details.commentary: The AI investment wave changed the technology landscape and concentrated gains in a few large stocks. That technology driven theme generated heavy trading and deal flow, creating fertile conditions for bank revenues.

AI enthusiasm fed a loop where rising valuations drove more trading and issuance, which lifted results for dealers like Goldman. Those strong results then validated the theme and encouraged more risk taking, keeping activity high into 2024.
